# StoreLeads plugin (Qikify / Ownego)

> Claude Code plugin + Vietnamese user guide for asking StoreLeads Shopify app/store data (24 monthly snapshots,
> Oct 2024 → Sep 2026) through the team Grafana (https://storedata.ecvision.ai, read-only). Internal use only.

## For an AI answering questions

- [Skill: data rules + SQL recipes](plugins/storeleads/skills/storeleads-grafana/SKILL.md)
- [Use cases: intent → recipes → caveats](plugins/storeleads/skills/storeleads-grafana/references/use-cases.md)
- [Category map (draft Level 1 / Level 2)](plugins/storeleads/skills/storeleads-grafana/references/categories.md)
- [Skill: shareable HTML reports (11 types)](plugins/storeleads/skills/storeleads-reports/SKILL.md)
- [Report types: blocks + text to write](plugins/storeleads/skills/storeleads-reports/references/report-types.md)
- [Report recipes: the SQL behind each report](plugins/storeleads/skills/storeleads-reports/references/recipes.md)
- [Command /storeleads:report](plugins/storeleads/commands/report.md)
- [Command /storeleads:competitor-brief](plugins/storeleads/commands/competitor-brief.md)
- [Command /storeleads:app-idea-check](plugins/storeleads/commands/app-idea-check.md)
- [Command /storeleads:category-scan](plugins/storeleads/commands/category-scan.md)
- [Command /storeleads:growth-check](plugins/storeleads/commands/growth-check.md)
- [Command /storeleads:churn-postmortem](plugins/storeleads/commands/churn-postmortem.md)
- [Command /storeleads:plus-gap](plugins/storeleads/commands/plus-gap.md)
